headline: Semiconductors: passing fear or buying opportunity?
summary: Nvidia reported its best quarter in its history, with revenue up 103% year on year. As of November 19, its shares were 39% below their October 6 peak.
why: Nvidia designs the AI accelerator chips that are central to data-center spending, making its results a key gauge for the semiconductor and AI sectors.

impacts.name: NVIDIA
impacts.why: The record quarter is reported, but the stock's direction is not stated beyond its distance from the October peak.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
